channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new fellowship - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Scuola Piccola Zattere: International Fellowship and Residency 2027 (Venice)
    https://scuolapiccolazattere.com/en/events/internationalfellowship-2-3
    Scuola Piccola Zattere · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 fellowship grant plus a EUR 2,000 research budget, accommodation in Venice, an individual study space within a shared studio, and round-trip travel to Venice. Collectives and duos share a single grant and one accommodation. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new fellowships - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:

    https://www.janvaneyck.nl/calendar/2-material-research-fellowships-2027/
    Jan van Eyck Academie (Future Materials / Future Threads programme, co-funded by the EU Just Transition Fund) · deadline Closed 24 Jun 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 1,750 (80% exempt from income tax) plus an annual working budget of EUR 2,250, a private studio apartment, and access to the Jan van Eyck Labs and external partners. Application fee EUR 50 excl. VAT (waived for applicants from DAC-list lower-income countries and territories).
  • French Institutes for Advanced Study (FIAS) Fellowship Programme 2027-2028
    https://www.fias-fp.eu/fellowships/call-applications-20272028
    French Institutes for Advanced Study (FIAS) network: Aix-Marseille, Cergy, Loire Valley (Orleans-Tours), Lyon, Montpellier, Nantes, Paris · deadline Closed 25 Jun 2026 · EUR 2,200/month living allowance; social security coverage; accommodation; research and training budget; travel expenses covered. No application fee.
  • Emergence Art+Science Fellowships: Open Call for New Commissions (Emergence Festival 2027)
    https://www.d-iep.org/artsciencefellowships
    Emergence at All Scales (EAAS), with The Science & Cocktails Foundation, Stichting Paradiso and NWA Route Kunst · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · Production budget up to EUR 20,000 including VAT per project (covers artist fees, materials, equipment, space, travel, accommodation, installation and presentation). item.title: 4 new fellowships - week of 27 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Bauhaus Earth: Experimental Fellowship 2026
    https://www.bauhauserde.org/projects/experimental-fellowship-bauhaus-earth
    Bauhaus Earth · deadline Closed 04 May 2026 · Monthly stipend + up to €30,000 for project-related expenses and production costs + technical support and expert collaborations
  • Einstein Fellowship 2026 (Einstein Forum + Wittenstein Foundation)
    https://www.einsteinforum.de/en/about/fellowship/
    Einstein Forum (with the Wittenstein Foundation) · deadline Closed 15 May 2026 · EUR 10,000 stipend + living accommodations for six months at Einstein's summerhouse + travel expense reimbursement
  • CAIS Research Sabbaticals (Fellowships) 2027-28
    https://www.cais-research.de/en/cais-college/fellowships/
    Center for Advanced Internet Studies (CAIS), Bochum, Germany · deadline Closed 23 Jul 2026 · Sabbatical leave on full salary: additional €600/month grant. No regular income: €2,000/month grant. Regular income below €1,400/month: top-up to the full grant. Alternative: reimbursement of salary or substitute costs within reasonable limits. €100/month extra per child under 18 for fellows on a full or compensatory grant. CAIS also covers one return trip to Bochum (or a daily commute if local), provides a rent-free fully furnished apartment and a private office. Fellows can request financial support for research expenses, invite a Visiting Fellow for up to 3 weeks of collaboration, and invite up to three European experts for half-day workshops (CAIS covers travel, accommodation and a daily allowance of up to €24).
  • Marie Skłodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026 (MSCA-PF)
    https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/funding/msca-postdoctoral-fellowships-2026
    European Commission (Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions, under Horizon Europe; managed by the European Research Executive Agency, REA) · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Standard MSCA unit costs covering researcher allowance (living, mobility, family), research/training/networking costs and management/indirect costs (annual values published in the call's Work Programme; typically a fully-funded postdoc package of roughly €5,000 to €8,000+ per researcher per month equivalent depending on host country correction coefficient)

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
